test_title: PYST 44: SSC GD Constable 2022 - English (Held On : 30 Jan 2023 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

Mike talks in an American ______.
solution: The correct answer is **"accent."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • An **accent** is a way of pronouncing words that shows where a person is from or what language they speak. • **"Accent"** means a particular way of pronouncing words that is connected with the country, area or social class that you come from. (शब्‍दों के उच्‍चारण का लहजा विशेष जो बोलने वाले के देश, निवासक्षेत्र या सामाजिक स्‍तर को दर्शाता है; स्‍वराघात) • **Example**: *He speaks with a strong Bengali **accent**__.* • The sentence conveys that Mike speaks with a British dialect. • The correct answer is Option 2. **Correct sentence**: *Mike talks in an American __**accent**__.* __ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** __ • **Option 1: Assent** means to agree or approve. (अधिकारिक स्‍वीकृति) • **Example:** *"The board gave their **assent**__ to the proposal."* • **Option 3: Ascend** means to go up or climb. (ऊपर चढ़ना; बढ़ना) __ • **Example**:* "The hikers began to **ascend**__ the mountain."* • **Option 4: Ascent** means the act of going up or climbing. (चढ़ाव, आरोहण) __ • **Example**: *"The **ascent**__ to the summit was difficult."* 35:T66b, Here, the erroneous part is **"you will ask him."**
